Name: Jas Sprite Edit
Author: SaintNyx
Description:
A simple edit of Jas's sprite. The edit is loosely based off of DC Burgers Portraits but is not necessary to enjoy. This mod edits her sprites, The winter outfit hasn't been changed except in one scene where her hair shows. I did my best to keep it looking vanilla to keep in line with the rest of the games sprites.
